sampleNote: GET wired to a Paradox SP-series panel (code 0x21) it controls directly; areas Home (armed) and Garage (disarmed, ready to arm); zones 1-2 in Home, 3-6 in Garage; Garage armed 07:42 and disarmed 17:18 today by Sample user. Invented data.
_fields: The Protegus app as a user uses it, for the Protegus app manual: screens that do not depend on the device, so files are named protegus-<shot>-<layout>.png (filePrefix). Step types as in new-system.json, plus click {css, text}: the match containing that text from the sample data. The sample system is sampleSystem 'areas' (lib/sample.mjs, sampleAreaSystem); a walk changes it with system (a patch; index keys change single areas or zones), zoneStatus (zone number -> alarm/failure/bypass) and openZones (zone numbers the panel names when it refuses to arm). Nothing a walk does is sent: arming is answered in the browser.

steps.note: Arm was pressed; no PIN is remembered for the area, so the app asks for one. Nothing has been sent yet.
The panel's answer (zones 4 and 5 open, so the area cannot arm) is simulated in the browser; nothing was sent to Protegus. The zone titles are the sample's zone names.
A PIN is remembered for Garage, so the area offers Forget PIN.
Back door is open, Garage window is bypassed, the other Garage zones are closed.
